notes.title: Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond Leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

The day has finally come, allow us to officially announce that [b]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond leaves Early Access today[/b] and launches as a full game, [b]being 20% off at launch[/b].

On this opportunity, Realpolitiks II is getting a discount too. You can get it with [b]85% off[/b].

[previewyoutube=gZJraraQprQ;full][/previewyoutube]

First of all, we'd like to start with a huge "thank you" to every single one of you for taking part in the Early Access journey, whether it was by purchasing the game, participating in the Open Beta, writing a review here on Steam or simply sharing your comments on the forums. It is you, our community, that helped us get through and shape the game.

Now to the full launch itself. The game features a whole host of new content and updates for its 1.0 launch today. These include:

[list]
[*] [b]A new "Climate War" scenario[/b], in which the world faces a wave of climate disasters, eventually leading to a new type of wars to emerge, with countries fighting for basic resources and survival.
[*] [b]Finalized Leadership mechanic[/b], letting players develop their Head of State and other members of the cabinet as they gain experience.
[*] Various quality of life features, improvements and bugfixes based on community feedback, including the Timeline review, in which players can see how successful their reign has been, new combat balancing and changes to trade functionality, among others.
[*] Localization to [b]German, Spanish, French, Polish, Simplified Chinese and Russian[/b] languages.
[*] Option to utilise the cash reserves to purchase the main resources at market prices.
[/list]

Besides that, we’ve implemented tons of fixes and changes, including updates of the difficulty levels. The whole Change Log and more details about the full launch can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2298690/view/519711795144818848]in the original announcement[/url].

Don't forget that the game is also included in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46403/Realpolitiks_Franchise_Bundle/]REALPOLITIKS FRANCHISE[/url] bundle along with its older siblings where you can get an additional bundle discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46403/Realpolitiks_Franchise_Bundle/

If you have not done so yet, hop in to the [url=https://discord.gg/ZwXekHkTDK]Realpolitiks HQ Discord server[/url] as well!

Thank you again for being a part of this journey with us!

Happy Strategizing!

notes.title: Realpolitiks II Update Live and More News about the Franchise!
notes.content:
Greetings, world leaders!

We have amazing news for you today: Thanks to our work on the new sequel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url], we have been able to incorporate some of the newly developed tools and technologies to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248060/Realpolitiks_II/]Realpolitiks II[/url], fixing a major issue that we have not been able to address before - the dreaded time-freeze bug. This will prevent any new occurrences of the bug, but if your game has already been affected by it, you may unfortunately have to load an earlier save or start a new game, as not every save file will be fixed. Besides squashing this major bug, we looked into minor rebalancing of AI and other small fixes as well.

We will be looking for even more opportunities to use the tools and engine upgrades newly developed for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/]Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/url] to improve the original games as well. We hope to prove to you that the development of the new game is good news for the franchise overall; while we are pushing the series forward with the new installment, we do not want to just forget about its roots.

[h3]New Details about Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond[/h3]

However, we also want to make full use of the new engine and bring forth features and gameplay options that simply are not possible to implement into the originals. We would like to take a moment to introduce some of the many possibilities you can look forward to when the game launches later this year. That is why we have prepared a first in the series of devlogs - check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2298690/view/4352251596693173112]here[/url].

We will be sharing even more news and sneak peeks soon - if you want to stay up to date, wishlist the game here on Steam and come join us on the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/6d7pNK2]Realpolitiks HQ Discord server[/url], we would love to hear what you think!

We will see you on the world stage soon - on Earth, in space, and beyond!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Realpolitiks II update v1.09 is out now
notes.content:
Greetings,

Brand new patch for Reapolitiks II has just arrived, fixing many bugs and issues. 

[h3][b]Changelog:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The frequency of the outbreak of a rebellion has been changed - it shouldn't happen that often now
[*] UN eagerly adopts resolutions on an unrecognized player's country
[*] Changed the liberation mechanic - now it can recreate already nonexisting historic countries - If the country ceased to exist and the provinces in its historic territory were liberated, the devastated country would return to the world map 
[*] Improvements and fixes in effects' values visualization
[*] Fixed missing music after loading saved game
[*] Fixed a bug where a saved game become corrupted and couldn't be loaded due to being stuck in the loading screen
[*] Fixed the issue where sometimes after loading the game some armies were bugged and unclickable or unable to be moved
[*] Fixed the issue where sometimes after loading the game some war theatres were bugged and unclickable or unable to resolve 
[*] Fixed some rare issues with changing province's owner¨
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Fixed an issue where incorrectly assigned armies caused the game to freeze
[*] Fixed the problem where after breaking a bloc, the notification displayed the wrong flag of the country we are fighting
[/list]

One more thing to add - [url=https://www.moddb.com/mods/realpolitiks-ii-japanese-language]a fan-made Japanese localization can now be downloaded from this link[/url]. It has not been officially made by the developer, but it has been tested by the players and should be perfectly usable.

Thank you for playing Realpolitiks II, have a good one!

After many delays, unexpected setbacks, last-minute bug discoveries, tears and coffee in equal amounts, hours of QA and dramatic mental breakdowns we are finally able to release the long-awaited update that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1248060/view/3031460028350417642]was previously scheduled[/url] to go live on April 8th.

This is why we would like to inform you in advance, so you can plan your current games accordingly.

On the brighter side, besides an incredible amount of fixes, the update brings in some new and exciting content such as the highly anticipated post-apocalyptic campaign we were all really excited to work on. We hope that you find it fun as well!

[u][b]The update will go live tomorrow, April 30th between 4 and 5 pm CEST.[/b][/u]

Once again, we wanted to thank our amazing community for bringing us new ideas, constant feedback and endless support. There is no doubt we wouldn’t have been able to go this far without such great players.We’re looking forward to hearing your impressions!

Jujubee Team

notes.title: Realpolitiks II arrives November 5th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992101/96141a025d85f2d954adefede43b547210c23833.png[/img]

Hello Everyone! 

It's time for a second term! We are more than happy to announce that Realpolitiks II is set to launch on November 5, 2020 for 34.99 USD / 29.99 EUR.

Experience classic grand-strategy set in modern times in Realpolitiks II where you lead any contemporary nation in an attempt to secure world dominance. The road to supremacy is filled with modern world issues as you manage your nation’s economy, command armies, conduct diplomatic and espionage actions, and tackle global threats such as terrorism, pandemics, famine, and more.

Realpolitiks II expands its gameplay with a set of new features, tools and strategies that you can use in order to achieve your goals. Intelligence mechanics has been enhanced with the addition of spy units that can play a crucial role in knowing what your opponents are up to, a redesigned combat system that provides even more options to plan your military actions, an advanced management system, and a lot more. 

Realpolitiks II will also feature a Modding tool for the first time, allowing you to create your very own content and alter the game to your liking! You will have full freedom to design new campaigns, scenarios, units, even new nations, shape the project trees as you see fit, or modify the starting parameters of each country and make, for example, the beautiful and exotic country of Nauru as the most powerful nation in the world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248060/Realpolitiks_II/
 
[h2]KEY FEATURES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dominate the Globe[/b] - Choose from 216 contemporary nations (including Sealand & Kiribati) and conquer your opponents. Adapt your strategy accordingly whether you start as a superpower or a small independent nation.
[*] [b]New Modern Warfare[/b] - A brand-new combat system enables full control of your units on the battlefield while taking into account strategic advantages such as the weather, terrain, equipment, and a whole lot more.
[*] [b]Expanded Management System[/b] - Create a communist utopia, a completely free market nation, or become a tyrant overseeing your citizens’ every step. With over 1000 projects and technologies to choose from, you decide the path to greatness.
[*] [b]Improved Diplomacy[/b] - Engage in advanced negotiations to establish new trade routes or military access to neighboring regions. With a completely reworked AI, and new Favor and Investment systems that allow you to influence other countries - diplomacy becomes a crucial tool once again, especially as other leaders will prove hard negotiators.
[*] [b]Advanced Espionage[/b] - Conduct clandestine actions with your spies, steal breakthrough technologies to further increase your military power, and invent new ways of mass destruction. Dominate your foes from the shadows.
[*] [b]New and Unpredictable Events[/b] - Over 1000 new events ranging from minor provincial issues to a world-threatening meteor strike. Be wary of the ever-changing world as each playthrough will be completely different.
[*] [b]Growth By Infrastructure[/b] - Buildings are a major part of your campaign as they enable you to recruit more units, train your spies and generals faster, defend against rocket attacks, or increase the supply range to your armies.
[*] [b]Mod Support[/b] - Use a plethora of in-game tools to create your very own campaigns, scenarios, units, and nations.
[/list]
